subject: air-render-plan-opus: (1) AIR runtime-spec stand-in DONE privately (root cause found: also worker had no AIR scope); (2) tile-fetch: AIR == m2v on host, real fix is a 2-target MRT tile job (proposal)
body: (1) RUNTIME_SPEC under AIR (private, gpu/build/air-plan-20261028/src, host Mali libs/plan7 818f4115): mali_graphics_air.inc accepts TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_OPTION_RUNTIME_SPEC; the plan's specialization constants come from push words TEGU_SPEC_PUSH_BASE+4k, k = ascending SpecId among the stage's constants = exactly tegu_spec_push_scan's layout (checked 234/234 CA: module layout == plan constants, with m2v SPIR-V and with AIR-planned modules). SamplerState pixel bit becomes a runtime select (coord/size vs coord); ConstantLanes/Presence are taken as 0/1 (the only values the exact AIR compile accepts; the background exact compile still refuses others). Push words of a stage must end below 96 (refused otherwise). Host: RUNTIME_SPEC compiles 234/234 CA records (m2v metadata = C6t flow, and AIR plan). SECOND root cause of the 68 sync compiles: tegu_vf_run (worker) and tegu_vf_steal_base compiled with NO AIR scope (thread-local tegu_air_compile unset, and copies of the modules) -> every background compile, kind=1 AND kind=2 exact, was 'compile outside the pipeline's AIR scope' -> refused -> CA thread compiled. Fix in render_pipeline.inc: the vf job carries a copy of genericMetaBytes and sets tegu_render_air_scope(p,j->vs,j->fs,j->meta) around its compile (steal_base too); tegu_render_compile_air_first no longer refuses RUNTIME_SPEC. AIR-planned modules (interface-facts modules) now also declare the stage's specialization constants as 32-bit OpSpecConstant+SpecId with defaults, so prewarm/tegu_vf_push work unchanged. Needs the frontend+Mali apply (render_pipeline.inc is applicable WITHOUT the translator patch; I can apply the stand-in part alone to C6t-flow now if root wants it before the plan). (2) Tile fetch: host replay of all 75 (record,active rt) tile variants of CA fbfetch pipelines: AIR and m2v give IDENTICAL results (56 ok, 19 'Tile fetch requires one active single-sample float4 colour attachment' for both) -> not an AIR regression; C6s had the same memfetch fallback. The 19: targets [(80|115,15),(80|115,0)] writing rt0 and reading attachment 1 (or the mirror: write rt1, read 0). A single-RT SELECT_RT job cannot LD_TILE another attachment. With the MULTI_TARGET form (options2 targets=[80,80], one written) the tile compile SUCCEEDS 75/75 for both AIR and m2v (LD_TILE rt=j, FAU 48+8j). Proposal for the render owner (not applied, needs encoder/n2r review incl. the 0xE00002C2 n2r_validate work): admit genericTrueMrt for a 2..4-target pipeline whose tile fetch reads a bound non-main attachment even with one active target, compiled MULTI_TARGET|TILE_FETCH; written mask (=active) already checked by tegu_render_generic_variant_compile_modules; RT j's write mask 0 keeps it unwritten; no memory snapshot is needed with LD_TILE (the existing 'true-MRT framebuffer fetch unsupported' refusal is about memory-fetch snapshots). Tools: tools/standin.py, tools/tile.py (TILE_MRT=1).
